answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. A plume of per-task receipts records who did what, and the ripple of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The fable of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, held in escrow until finality, each submission carries a fresh nonce.
